step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram depicts an automated server migration process from on-premises to AWS. The Migration Team interacts via Slack, which triggers an EC2 Migration Factory instance and updates DynamoDB. On-premise servers send metadata to App Discovery Service and replicate block data to an EC2 Hot Replica via CloudEndure. The EC2 Migration Factory coordinates with App Discovery Service and CloudEndure, bakes an AMI, shares it to the target account, and launches the target EC2 instance using the Shared AMI.
